title: Supply Tenure Bonus on Commercial Natural Gas Supply Renewals
content:
**The bonus.** A tenure bonus is added to a Commercial Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit for long supply. The supply months are the whole calendar months from the service start date to the acceptance date, a month counting only once the acceptance date's day of the month has reached the start date's.

| Supply months | Tenure bonus |
|---|---|
| At least 48 | $40.00 |
| At least 24 and fewer than 48 | $20.00 |
| Fewer than 24 | No tenure bonus |

The tenure bonus is added to the loyalty credit after the base credit has been multiplied, and the bonus itself is not multiplied.

## Training questions (hypothetical dates)

**Service start 2021-09-15, acceptance 2025-09-14.** The 15th of September 2025 has not been reached, so the supply months are 47: the bonus is $20.00.

**Service start 2021-09-15, acceptance 2025-09-15.** 48 supply months: the bonus is $40.00.

**Service start 2023-10-31, acceptance 2025-10-30.** Day 30 has not reached day 31, so the supply months are 23: no tenure bonus.

**Service start 2023-10-31, acceptance 2025-10-31.** 24 supply months: the bonus is $20.00.

**Where does the service start date come from?** From the agreement record of the Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas agreement being renewed.
